raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Inkling cannot start with an expert-parallel size that does not divide its 256
routed experts (e.g. `--data-parallel-size 3 --tensor-parallel-size 2
--enable-expert-parallel`, EP=6). Weight loading fails on the last EP rank
(vLLM 0.32.0):

```
vllm/models/inkling/nvidia/moe.py:608, in load_expert_weight
    slab = weight[gid].narrow(0, tp_rank * 2 * half, 2 * half)
IndexError: index 256 is out of bounds for dimension 0 with size 256
```

`InklingMoE` pads the routed expert count to a multiple of the EP size so the
TRTLLM MoE kernels get equal per-rank slabs (`moe.py:440`, 256 → 258 on EP6),
and `finalize_load` already zeroes those padding slots. `load_expert_weight`,
however, iterates over every local slot from `_local_expert_slots()`, including
the padding ids (256, 257), and indexes the checkpoint tensor with them.

This PR filters the padding slots (`gid >= n_routed_experts`) out of the slot
map in `load_expert_weight`, for both the NVIDIA and AMD implementations. The
padding behaviour itself is unchanged; the router only selects among the
`n_routed_experts` real experts, so padding slots are never routed to.

Power-of-two EP sizes (no padding) are unaffected: the filter is a no-op there.

## Duplicate check

- Searched open/closed issues and PRs for: `inkling expert parallel`,
  `load_expert_weight`, `inkling out of bounds`, `non-power-of-two`, `EP6`.
  No existing report or fix.
- #64690 also edits `load_expert_weight`, but for layerwise weight reload
  (routing writes through `weight_loader`); it does not handle padding slots.
  The two changes touch adjacent lines and may need a trivial rebase.

## Test Plan

Unit test (added to `tests/models/inkling/test_moe_weight_layout.py`, which the
`inkling-unit-tests-b200` Buildkite step already runs): a rank owning
`{2: 0, 3: 1}` with a 3-expert checkpoint must load expert 2 and leave the
padding slot untouched, for a per-expert weight (`w2_weight`) and a
per-expert scalar scale (`w13_weight_scale_2`). The two existing
`load_expert_weight` tests now also set `n_routed_experts` on their fake layer.

```bash
pytest tests/models/inkling/test_moe_weight_layout.py -v
```

The unit tests were run against a vLLM 0.32.0 install, whose
`load_expert_weight` is identical to `main`, with the patched module swapped in.

End-to-end on 6× B200 (vLLM 0.32.0, whose `load_expert_weight` is identical to
`main`), `thinkingmachines/Inkling-NVFP4`:

```bash
vllm serve thinkingmachines/Inkling-NVFP4 \
  --data-parallel-size 3 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --reasoning-parser inkling --tool-call-parser inkling --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
```

## Test Result

Unit test, before the fix:

```
FAILED test_moe_weight_layout.py::test_moe_skips_ep_padding_experts_during_load[w13_weight_scale_2-...]
FAILED test_moe_weight_layout.py::test_moe_skips_ep_padding_experts_during_load[w2_weight-...]
E   IndexError: index 3 is out of bounds for dimension 0 with size 3
2 failed, 33 passed
```

After the fix:

```
35 passed
```

End-to-end, EP6:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| startup | `IndexError` during weight loading | starts (`Local/global number of experts: 43/258`, 106.81 GiB weights per GPU) |
| 18 concurrent short factual prompts, greedy | – | 18/18 correct (one answered `H₂O` vs expected `H2O`) |
| image / audio / tool-call requests | – | correct |
| MTP acceptance (3 draft tokens) | – | 56.6 % (all 3 DP engines served traffic) |

Misplaced or garbage experts on the padded ranks would have shown up as
broken output and a collapsed MTP acceptance rate.

The AMD change is the same filter; it was not run on AMD hardware.

## AI assistance

AI assistance (Claude) was used to locate the bug, write the change and test,
and draft this description. I reviewed every changed line; the tests and the
end-to-end run above were executed on our B200 server under my direction.

@@ -170,6 +170,7 @@ def test_moe_loads_compressed_tensors_global_scale(
     )
     layer = SimpleNamespace(
         experts=SimpleNamespace(routed_experts=experts),
+        n_routed_experts=3,
         _local_expert_slots=lambda: {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2},
     )
     checkpoint_scale = torch.tensor([[1.0], [2.0], [3.0]])
@@ -198,6 +199,7 @@ def test_moe_loads_channelwise_scale_for_tp(
     )
     layer = SimpleNamespace(
         experts=SimpleNamespace(routed_experts=experts),
+        n_routed_experts=3,
         _local_expert_slots=lambda: {0: 0, 2: 1},
     )
     checkpoint_scale = torch.arange(3 * checkpoint_rows).reshape(3, checkpoint_rows, 1)
@@ -213,6 +215,35 @@ def test_moe_loads_channelwise_scale_for_tp(
     assert loaded == [f"experts.routed_experts.{projection}_weight_scale"]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("key", "param_shape", "checkpoint_shape"),
+    [("w2_weight", (2, 4, 3), (3, 4, 3)), ("w13_weight_scale_2", (2, 2), (3, 1))],
+)
+def test_moe_skips_ep_padding_experts_during_load(
+    key: str, param_shape: tuple[int, ...], checkpoint_shape: tuple[int, ...]
+) -> None:
+    """A rank whose EP slab ends in alignment padding (e.g. 256 experts on EP6)
+    owns slots past the checkpoint's last expert; only real experts load."""
+    param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(param_shape))
+    experts = SimpleNamespace(
+        **{key: param},
+        moe_config=SimpleNamespace(moe_parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(tp_rank=0)),
+    )
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        experts=SimpleNamespace(routed_experts=experts),
+        n_routed_experts=3,
+        _local_expert_slots=lambda: {2: 0, 3: 1},
+    )
+    checkpoint = torch.arange(1.0, 1.0 + torch.Size(checkpoint_shape).numel())
+    checkpoint = checkpoint.reshape(checkpoint_shape)
+
+    loaded = moe.InklingMoE.load_expert_weight(layer, f"experts.{key}", checkpoint)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(param[0], checkpoint[2].expand_as(param[0]))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(param[1], torch.zeros_like(param[1]))
+    assert loaded == [f"experts.routed_experts.{key}"]
+
+
 def test_sink_down_projection_is_packed_during_load(monkeypatch) -> None:
     monkeypatch.setattr(moe, "get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 2)
     monkeypatch.setattr(moe, "get_tensor_model_parallel_rank", lambda: 1)

@@ -604,7 +604,13 @@ def load_expert_weight(self, name: str, weight: torch.Tensor) -> list[str]:
             )
 
         param = getattr(experts, key)
-        slots = self._local_expert_slots()
+        # EP-alignment padding experts have no checkpoint tensor; they are
+        # zeroed in finalize_load.
+        slots = {
+            g: s
+            for g, s in self._local_expert_slots().items()
+            if g < self.n_routed_experts
+        }
         gids = sorted(slots)
         lids = [slots[g] for g in gids]
         tp_rank = experts.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_rank

@@ -573,7 +573,13 @@ def load_expert_weight(self, name: str, weight: torch.Tensor) -> list[str]:
             return [f"experts.routed_experts.{projection}_input_scale"]
 
         param = getattr(experts, key)
-        slots = self._local_expert_slots()
+        # EP-alignment padding experts have no checkpoint tensor; they are
+        # zeroed in finalize_load.
+        slots = {
+            g: s
+            for g, s in self._local_expert_slots().items()
+            if g < self.n_routed_experts
+        }
         gids = sorted(slots)
         lids = [slots[g] for g in gids]
